articles.title: Forgotten by the World, Spider-Man Faces a Villain Only He Can Sense
articles.summary: The new 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' trailer reveals Peter Parker grappling with isolation after Doctor Strange's spell erased him from everyone's memory. Now, he's experiencing a strange mutation and battling Scorpion, ninjas, and the Hulk—plus a mysterious foe only he can detect. The film hits theaters July 31, 2026.

articles.title: A Swirling Milky Vortex in Europe's Largest Lake Captured from Space
articles.summary: An astronaut's photo reveals a massive, milky-green vortex in Lake Skadar, a biodiversity hotspot on the Montenegro-Albania border. The swirl is sediment—limestone and dolomite—stirred by currents and snowmelt. The lake is a cryptodepression, with most of its floor below sea level.

articles.title: The Light Flip Is a $299 Dumb Phone That's Actually Cool
articles.summary: Light Phone's new Light Flip dumps the touchscreen for a retro design with a D-pad and T9 typing. Priced at $299, it's aimed at Gen Z users fed up with smartphones. No social media, just core tools like calls, texts, and directions. Ships April 2027.
